name: Energosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Rauisuchidae (a grade of 'rauisuchians'); the atlas keeps that parent.
sum: Energosuchus is a rauisuchian from the upper Karyomayol and lower Synya formations of Russia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Bukobay Formation per PBDB.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Ochev 1986

sources.text: V. G. Ochev. 1986. [On Middle Triassic reptiles of the southern Cis-Urals]. Ezhegodnik Vsesoyuznogo Paleontologicheskogo Obshchesiva 29:171-180
